Class WaitingRoom

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.rooms.Room
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.rooms.WaitingRoom
All Implemented Interfaces:
Disconnectable, VirtualRoomServer, Serializable, Remote
public class WaitingRoom extends Room implements VirtualRoomServer
The WaitingRoom class represents a game room that is currently in the pre-game phase. It gathers players until the maximum capacity is reached. Once full, it initiates a countdown before automatically converting into a playing room and starting the match.

  • Method Details

    • disconnect

      public void disconnect(DisconnectPacket disconnectPacket) throws Exception
      Handles the explicit network disconnection of a player currently in the waiting room. Removes the player from the room's list, updates the remaining clients, and forwards the disconnection event to the main server.
      Specified by:
      disconnect in interface Disconnectable
      Parameters:
      disconnectPacket - the packet containing the nickname of the disconnected player.
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during the broadcasting or server disconnection.

    • enterPlayer

      public void enterPlayer(PhasedProxyPlayer newPlayer) throws Exception
      Processes a new player entering the waiting room. If there is space, it changes the player's phase to 'ROOM', binds them to the room, updates their client, and checks if the room has reached full capacity to start the countdown. If the room is full, an exception is thrown.
      Overrides:
      enterPlayer in class Room
      Parameters:
      newPlayer - the PhasedProxyPlayer attempting to enter.
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the room is already full.
      Exception - if a network or synchronization error occurs.

      public PlayingRoom convertIntoPlaying()
